summary: Day of the Tentacle entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Day of the Tentacle
entries.definitive_edition: Day of the Tentacle Remastered on PC, with original route via ScummVM if needed

emulation.emulator: ScummVM optional for original DOS/Mac versions
emulation.notes: Use native remaster for primary; use ScummVM/original assets for original behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Remastered PC for modern presentation; original hardware/assets for original route

primary.why: The remaster is the modern PC route with high-resolution art, remastered audio, commentary, and the ability to switch between classic and remastered modes. The original DOS/Mac releases remain useful for original presentation and Maniac Mansion-in-game behavior checks.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam/GOG remaster. Record graphics/audio/UI mode, commentary state, language, save route, Maniac Mansion access if checked, and whether original DOS/ScummVM behavior was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting original release behavior.
secondary.why: The remaster changes presentation while preserving classic switching.

secondary.exclusive_content: Playable Maniac Mansion inside Day of the Tentacle
secondary.what_to_play: Document as an included easter-egg route if relevant.
secondary.why: It is not part of the main Day of the Tentacle completion route.

all_releases.platform: Windows PC / macOS / Linux / PlayStation / Xbox / mobile remaster
all_releases.fidelity: High-resolution remaster with classic switching and commentary.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The remaster is the best modern route, but original presentation should be checked with classic mode or original assets when accuracy matters.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record classic/remastered toggles and whether in-game Maniac Mansion was documented.
